title: NSE Indices launches Nifty AI Catalysts Index
text: NSE Indices launches Nifty AI Catalysts Index. The index provides exposure to companies involved in critical infrastructure and services supporting AI deployment and adoption. These include computing and IT infrastructure, connectivity, power and electrification, cooling systems, engineering and construction, and cables and materials supporting digital infrastructure.
